claims.claim_text: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, establishing runtime gate verdict contracts, GraphRAG grounding, and human override paths across multi-agent orchestration.
Drove enterprise AI platform adoption by instrumenting consumption and renewal signals that aligned expansion motion directly to CFO priorities.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, pairing evaluation gates and telemetry with rollback controls for release reliability.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks.
Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse pipelines supporting dense sparse exact retrieval for enterprise AI platforms.
Commercialized reusable AI platform capability across enterprise lines of business while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 to sustain delivery growth.
